jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Landscape Humanity Handbook daily scene in fine brown ink and luminous natural watercolour on warm ivory paper. Late-autumn low-elevation wooded limestone valley of northern Iberia. Image 1 supplies ONLY original modern traveller identity and style: lean ordinary adult around thirty, ear-length dark wavy hair, short beard, natural two arms/two legs and capable hands. Never copy its old lean-to, near-naked clothes or older equipment. Image 2 supplies ONLY current full dated WARDROBE.
Keep ONE dull TAN hair-in sleeveless wrap over BOTH shoulders, overlapping front, irregular hem above knees, old anatomical-LEFT shoulder repair, chest tie below throat, narrow waist/hip keeper. Plain grey-brown rabbit crown with tan fox side/ear/nape extension, face open, no animal ears or muzzle, hood or fox shoulder strip. Fox material is entirely in cap; old grass torso screens stored. BOTH feet ENCLOSED in LOW PALE-TAN skin covers, inward grass/hair, original woven BAST SOLES beneath/outside and low ties. Toes and heels CLOSED, low ankle tops, bare lower legs. No new leggings, cloak, sleeves or extra skin. No invented scars/tattoos. Keep full readable natural anatomy.
One actual chosen moment, no montage, text, labels, watermark or numbered construction plan. Neutral cropped natural setting, no new map layout, no abandoned lean-to, sawn modern workshop or indoor fire. Image 3 gives ONLY the same small OPEN ROUND unglazed grey-tan bowl shape, modest irregular rim, rounded base, no handles, lid or foot ring. Chosen moment after cooking, complete cooling and washing: man sits simply at craft-side rock, setting ONE EMPTY COOL WASHED pot onto its short simple drying board with both natural hands. No steam, active fire, hot handling, water pouring, food, new vessel or greenware. Current both closed skin foot covers over bast soles and cap/body wrap all present. Some wet ground or dripping stone beyond protected area suggests overnight rain, while craft board remains dry under natural rock edge. No full moon, bright night sky, old lean-to, fire under cover or new furniture. Daylight quiet after ordinary useful work, not a separate reflection frontispiece.

attempts.review: One cooled washed earthenware pot on a board, wet exterior and dry natural rock shelter. Complete cap/wrap and low closed footwear retained; no extra pottery or indoor fire.

jobs.scene: A moonless closing appraisal beneath natural rock, with the useful cooled pot and unchanged full clothing.
jobs.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Wide painted frontispiece for Humanity Handbook Reflection 07, completed Day 89 NEW MOON. Express the feeling of an improved working home and patient unfinished work. Watercolour with matte gouache and sparse graphite on ivory, richer quiet dark-blue/grey valley and restrained warm light. Image 1 ONLY original traveller identity, Image 2 ONLY current full clothing, Image 3 ONLY painted reflection PALETTE/MOOD, Image 4 ONLY the current small pot form. NEVER copy Image 3's full-moon disk, old lean-to, bare torso, fox shoulder strip or old equipment.
Same lean human man around thirty, dark wavy ear-length hair, short beard. Plain rabbit crown with tan fox ear/nape extension, worn TAN sleeveless hair-in wrap over BOTH shoulders, chest tie, above-knee hem and waist keeper. Both feet fully CLOSED in low pale-tan pelt covers over woven bast soles, lower legs bare. No new cloak, hood, leggings or animal-head cap, no fox strip on shoulder.
He sits quietly at the DRY MOUTH of a shallow natural ROCK OVERHANG, ordinary simple seated anatomy, exactly two arms/two legs, hands resting naturally, feet readable. Looking outward over a broad darkening late-autumn limestone valley after rain. A modest overlapping bark/brush screen edge and SMALL existing lower mud bay may be cropped at one side; the natural rock carries the roof, NO light frame holding rock and NO old lean-to. ONE small empty washed fired pot rests on a separate simple board in the dry craft strip. ONE substantial pale STRAIGHT UNFINISHED WOODEN STAVE lies relaxed on low separate clean rests, no fitted string, curve, nocks, arrows, finished bow or extra hides. It represents waiting work, not a hunting trophy. Omit all other stock rather than invent quantities.
New-moon twilight: NO visible lunar disk, full moon, moonbeam or silver spotlight; faint dusk/first stars and clouds are enough. Subtle warmth can spill from the ordinary outdoor hearth OUTSIDE the frame and beyond the drip line; absolutely NO flames, embers or indoor fire under rock. Outside wet ground, inside dry resting/craft strip. No fantasy industry, spacecraft, drawings of asteroid, teaching crowd, triumphant conquest or maps. Contemplative, grounded, competent but aware of unfinished winter needs. No text or labels.

attempts.reason: Cap crown disappeared into a thin headband with exposed hair; violates the established full rabbit crown and fox ear/nape extensions.

attempts.review: Full rounded fur cap covers crown and has tan ear/nape extensions, tan sleeveless wrap over both shoulders and both low closed pale skin covers over bast soles. attempts.full_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A contemplative landscape frontispiece for Humanity Handbook Reflection 07, new moon at the start of Moon 4. Fine ink and luminous watercolour/gouache on warm ivory paper, muted blue twilight and warm tan skin clothing, natural northern Iberian wooded limestone valley in late autumn. Image 1 gives ONLY original modern traveller identity and ink/watercolour style: lean ordinary adult about thirty, dark ear-length wavy hair and short beard; do not copy old near-naked clothing or lean-to. Image 2 gives the COMPLETE CURRENT CLOTHING: MOST IMPORTANT, a FULL PLAIN FUR CAP covers his WHOLE CROWN and TOP of head, a grey-brown rabbit-fur crown with tan fox-fur side, ear and nape extensions. The cap is a complete substantial rounded hat, never a headband, no bare crown or exposed top-of-head hair, no animal face, muzzle or upright ears. Face open. Tan hair-in sleeveless wrap covers BOTH shoulders and torso, left shoulder repair, chest tie, narrow waist keeper, hem above knees. Bare lower legs. BOTH FEET enclosed in low pale tan skin foot covers with closed toes and heels, low ankle tops, original woven bast soles beneath/outside, low ties. No leggings, sleeves, hood, extra cloak or fur shoulder strip. The hat and both feet must remain readable. Image 3 gives ONLY the single rough fired earthenware pot form. Scene: he sits quietly on a low rock under a natural rock overhang, hands resting naturally on knees, looking across the darkening valley. One empty cooled plain fired pot stands on a small flat board to his side. No other equipment or projects need appear. Two arms, two legs, relaxed believable anatomy, full seated figure. No indoor fire, no modern furniture, no built roof or mud house. Rock supplies all overhead cover. A few faint stars in a dusky sky but NO VISIBLE MOON, crescent or moon disc: it is new moon. Spacious thoughtful atmosphere, no text, labels or montage. Retain his full cap and all dated clothing exactly; this is reflection after practical winter work, no new equipment or wardrobe.
